study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter, prospective cohort study
outcome: hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia with or without severe features)
cohort: Nulliparous pregnant patients with singleton gestations who delivered at or after 37+0 weeks' gestation were included in this secondary analysis.
finding: The incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy increased with advancing gestational age among all ongoing pregnancies but decreased with advancing gestational age among deliveries at that specific gestational age week.
gest_age: delivery at or after 37+0 weeks' gestation
